statement_en: If $f \in L^1(\mathbb{T})$, then $|\hat{f}(n)|\to 0$. More precisely, $$\hat{f}(n) = \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} f(x)e^{-inx} \, dx \to 0 \text{ as } |n| \to \infty.$$
callout_body:
$f \in L^1(\mathbb{T})$那么$|\hat{f}(n)|\to 0$具体来说:
$$\hat{f}(n) =
\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} f(x)e^{-inx} dx \to 0 \text{
as } |n| \to \infty$$
